blocks.title: Google Ads That Actually Deliver ROI
paragraphs: Google processes billions of searches every day — and the businesses appearing at the top of those results are winning customers their competitors never even get a chance to reach. Google Ads is the most powerful intent-driven advertising platform in the world — but only when it's managed the right way.

Poorly set up campaigns waste budget on irrelevant clicks, wrong audiences, and underperforming keywords. True Line's certified Google Ads specialists build, manage, and optimize campaigns that target the right people, at the right time, with the right message — turning your ad spend into measurable business results.

Whether you're running Google Ads for the first time or looking to fix underperforming campaigns, True Line brings the strategy, technical depth, and ongoing optimization your campaigns need to perform.

items.q: How much should I spend on Google Ads?
items.a: There's no one-size-fits-all answer. Budget depends on your industry, competition, and goals. We help you determine a realistic starting budget and scale it as results prove ROI. Most UAE businesses see strong results starting from AED 3,000–5,000 per month in ad spend.

items.q: How long before I see results?
items.a: Google Search campaigns can drive leads within days of launch. For full optimization and consistent results, allow 60–90 days as data accumulates and campaigns are refined.

items.q: Do you charge a management fee on top of ad spend?
items.a: Yes — our management fee covers strategy, setup, optimization, and reporting. Your ad spend goes directly to Google. We are fully transparent about both costs.

items.q: Can you take over existing campaigns?
items.a: Absolutely. We audit your existing campaigns, identify issues and opportunities, and take over full management — often improving performance significantly from day one.
Results vary by industry, budget, and competition. We set realistic expectations upfront, track performance closely, and optimize continuously to improve your cost per lead and return on ad spend.
